column1: #   case_id  phase(setfreq|hop|converge)  freq  width  center  set_tier  tx_probe
# width uses iw set-freq tokens (HT20/HT40-/HT40+/NOHT/5/10/80/160/80+80); center '-' = absent.
#   The managed template latched at monitor entry stays valid on its own
#   frequency/width (or narrowed to 20 MHz). Every other channel falls back to
#   the constructed context, which follows the monitor width (HT>=40, 5G VHT
#   >=80, 6G HE incl. widths) since the v7 maxsqueeze unlock.
# Coverage: every iw-phy channel NOT flagged disabled on v10 (2.4G ch1-14,
# 5G 36-173, 6G ch1-233) plus width probes. DFS-family 5G rows stay
# observation (radar/CAC is FW-owned); 5885/ch177 and 5935/ch2 are disabled
# in the live regdom and intentionally excluded.
#   must_complete         set must be accepted and the frame must get a FW
#   must_refuse_either    a precise refusal at either layer passes: the set
#                         itself refused with an errno, or the set was
#                         accepted and TX terminally rejected with
#   observation           outcome recorded, no pass/fail judgement
#   '-'                   no TX probe for this row
# hop rows: 12 rapid set-freq cycles (no per-hop TX; latency + persona survival)
# converge row: width AUTO = 80MHz/5775 in template mode, HT20 in constructed
